name: Jellyfin Now Playing
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Shows what's playing on your Jellyfin server: poster art, title, and playback progress

versions.notes: Initial release: polls the Jellyfin /Sessions API and shows the active session's poster (series poster for TV episodes), scrolling title and subtitle, a paused indicator, and a progress bar that moves smoothly between polls. Includes username and content-type filters, a Nothing Playing screen, and on-panel setup/error messages on all four panel sizes.
